problem_keywords: explain command fails without docs folder
guides not accessible in installed rebar
propositions: explain guide markdown is read from config.repo_root()/docs/, which resolves to the consuming project's git toplevel rather than the rebar package installation, causing missing-file errors when rebar is installed as a library/CLI/MCP and run against a project without docs/
rebar explain plan, rebar explain review, and rebar explain <criterion-id> fail when the target project lacks a docs/ tree, even though the guides are packaged with rebar itself
the author guides and criterion registry must be accessible via importlib.resources from the rebar package instead of from the consuming project's repo_root to match OSS runtime-data conventions
explain_guide() and explain_criterion() must resolve guide content independently of repo_root to ensure guides are available from any rebar installation
